Order.description:
One order: what to pay, where, and how far the payment has got.

Its status moves from `pending` through `unconfirmed` and `confirming`
to `paid` (or `partial`, `overpaid`, `expired`); `is_final` says it
won't change again. Follow `mk:order-events` to hear each change as it
happens, and send the payer to `mk:checkout`.

post.description:
Make an order.

With the store's secret key or an app's (a shop's server, a till) it is
recorded as made with the key; with the public key it's the website's,
and a store that takes orders only from its verified websites refuses it
from anywhere else. A shop plugin names itself in `Monokulo-Client:
<slug>/<version>`. Answers `201 Created` with the order and its
`Location`.

tags.description:
The API's entry: where to go from here.

Links to the store, its orders and its events (and, for a connected
app, the app itself), the forms the key may use, and the API's
description. A link or form the key may not use is left out, so a
client can find out what its key does by reading this.
tags.name: root

tags.description:
The connected app the key belongs to.

Only an app's own key (`ak_`) has one. The app shows it in its
settings, and disconnects itself with the `disconnect` form.
tags.name: app

tags.description:
The store's sale events, as server-sent events: one stream for all its orders.

It starts with `ready`; then each sale event is an `event:` named after it (`sale.waiting`, `sale.paid`, `sale.expired`, ...) with its JSON as data. `lagged` means some were missed: read the orders again. A connected app's stream ends when the app is disconnected.
tags.name: events

tags.description:
Where a shop plugin sends its warnings and errors, when its "Send errors to Monokulo" option is on.

They are kept, on the instance admin's Logs page, only when the store turned client logs on (structured_logging.md 2.4).
tags.name: logs

tags.name: openapi

tags.description:
One order: what to pay, where, and how far the payment has got.

Its status moves from `pending` through `unconfirmed` and `confirming`
to `paid` (or `partial`, `overpaid`, `expired`); `is_final` says it
won't change again. Follow `mk:order-events` to hear each change as it
happens, and send the payer to `mk:checkout`.
tags.name: order

tags.description:
One order's changes, as server-sent events.

An `order` event carries the order (the same JSON as reading it) each time it changes, and every 30 seconds as its time to pay runs down; the stream ends once the order is final, after a last `order` event. `done` with `not_found` ends it for an order that's gone.
tags.name: order-events
